## Relational Dance Dance is an interactive memoir and dance rhythm game that explores memories stored in the body, relational healing, and learning to step into new patterns.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/IMXpjg6EIQg?si=IsA5Y_0dLZYCI_Dg" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Dance along to an original soundtrack representing anxious coping mechanisms, such as "Walkin' on Eggshells" and "Chasing Breadcrumbs". Clear all five songs to unlock a secret poetic ending, where patterns are broken, and a new dance can be learned.

This game is a work-in-progress and is set to launch in 2027.

## Selected exhibitions
- __Game Devs of Color Showcase__, Bubblesort Studios, March 2026, San Francisco
- __POPUP INTERNET CAFE__, Bubblesort Studios, March 2026, San Francisco
- __NEUROMANTICS__, Underground Art and Design x Danielle Paterson, December 2025, NYC
- __coming of age__, All St Gallery, September 2025, New York City
- __Random Access Memories: Residency Showcase__, Centre for Culture and Technology, July 17-19 2025, Toronto

### Demo at Vector Art Festival, Toronto

I was able to start work on this game with support from InterAccess's [Vector Festival](https://vectorfestival.org/) Game Art Residency in Toronto, where residents displayed pieces as part of the [random access memories](https://vectorfestival.org/game-art-residency-showcase) showcase in July 2025.

Big thanks to Patrick Egbuchulam, my music collaborator! 
And thank you to InterAccess Toronto, CultureHub, tiat, NarraScope Conference–and many friends including Todd Anderson, Chia Amisola, Danielle Paterson, Queenie Wu, and Paizley Lee–for supporting this project across its various lives and iterations.
